page.overview:
Who is Hikari Uchiha?

She was originally born as "Hikari Uchiha" by her parents, who wished her to live her life in the sunshine as much as possible, hence her name. However, her parents were killed at some point during the vicious Warring States Period, leaving her orphaned. Once her fellow Uchiha clan members discovered Nanashi's powerful abilities, they decided to use her as a weapon for battle, telling her only purpose was to serve them in battle, and gave her the name "Nanashi" to signify her lack of identity as a human being. For several years, Nanashi was kept locked away by her own clansmen, being treated as a weapon, often being referred only as "it" by others. There, they inflicted painful ocular techniques on Nanashi and implanted various ocular powers into her eyes. Ultimately, however, during a battle against the Senju clan, Nanashi's power forced them to retreat, only for them to return with assistance from the Sarutobi clan, who managed to defeat the Uchiha and seal Nanashi away underground, preventing her from being used again for battle.

Because of the extreme mistreatment she suffered at the hands of her own clan, being treated as nothing more than a weapon, not even being referred to as a human being, but only as an object, Nanashi developed a deep hate for not only her own clan, but shinobi as a whole, along with reality itself. As a result, Nanashi eagerly accepted Merz's offer to bring chaos to the world in order to gain her revenge upon shinobi.

When she posed as the guide for Ninja Heroes, she seems to act robotic and unnatural to everyone except Boruto, where she will act and talk more human and natural, using systematic words and being polite, When she does it, she will only talk about what's happening in the virtual shinobi world and the Ninja Heroes, never talking about anything. When asked about the events, she states that there are no events at this time. and if asked where to start, she states that all beginners must read the manual page 13 before playing. She won't express herself, either via poses or facial expressions, She will drop that facade when confronted about what she actually is, being a Zero supporter, and that there are many things pointing at her.

Upon meeting Boruto Uzumaki in the virtual game world she created, Nanashi began having conflicting feelings; while initially annoyed with Boruto's persistence to talk to her and impress her, she gradually found him interesting and different from others, who only talked to her as part of her duties as a "guide" for the game, whereas Boruto genuinely wished to become her friend.
